dedupe_keys.name: plans de mise en accessibilite de la voirie et des espaces public

description: Plans de mise en accessibilité de la voirie et des espaces public is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartelie.application.developpement-durable.ader.gouv.fr. State of play of road and road accessibility plans Public Spaces (PAVE). The PAVE is drawn up by the municipality or by the inter-municipality if this jurisdiction has been transferred to him. It specifies the measures to be adopted to make accessible all pedestrian paths and parking areas on the inter-municipal (or communal) territory. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Accessibility plans for roads and public spaces" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Réseaux de transport, Cartes interactives. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2012-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
